notes: «قال وأخبرني محمد بن المنكدر» continues from Ibn Jurayj, as in the «قال وحدثني» pattern: a second route on the same head (rule 3, example 3)
«بنحو حديث ابن عيينة» names another report: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
The first route ends at Jabir without its own saying; the saying after the second route belongs to both
